calculation.ue_quaternion: For half-angle sine/cosine SP/SY/SR and CP/CY/CR: X=CR*SP*SY-SR*CP*CY; Y=-CR*SP*CY-SR*CP*SY; Z=CR*CP*SY-SR*SP*CY; W=CR*CP*CY+SR*SP*SY
calculation.cloth_capsule_axis: Capsule fitted center=L/2 along bone-local X, cylinderLength=L-2r. Cap-center axis is d=r..L-r. Surface clearance estimate=min(anatomyPhi(capCenter(d))-r)
calculation.sampling_note: Continuous phi is 1-Lipschitz; nearest sample overestimate is bounded by half the axis sample spacing for unchanged primitive transforms. This is a computed capsule separation bound, not rendered vertex penetration. Four current-pose anatomy bodies are available; a negative result would prove overlap against that subset, but positive cannot exclude unavailable body shapes. Reference evaluates all18 anatomy shapes.
calculation.rest_joint_orientation: worldFrame2=kinParentWorldQuaternion*rawLocalRootRefQuaternion (new saved Frame1 identity and Frame2 ref-local rotation). Reconstructed from rounded ref data, not a new actual saved-frame readback.

reference.conclusion: The full reference capsule is clear of the existing anatomy proxies; reference embedding is not supported.

current_stage3.conclusion: Motion of the right thigh reduces root-region capsule clearance from about4.82cm in reference pose to about0.08cm in this snapshot. The locked pivot is accurately maintained; this snapshot has only about8.99degrees joint deflection. It is not the83.17degree peak frame and does not prove geometry penetration at that peak.

precision_and_limits: Native component/local transforms are printed to six decimals; geometry centers to three decimals, radii/lengths to five decimals. Quaternions are recalculated from native Pitch/Yaw/Roll fields with UE formula. Results are approximate text-derived calculations.

Imported reference wrapper100 removed only from component translations; anatomy/cloth shape dimensions were not divided again. Very small imported scale residuals are normalized to1 consistently with existing native author.

Reference root Phi5.056201 reproduces native author5.056269cm within text-rounding precision; current computations use source primary anatomy shapes rather than disabled imported Leg skeleton broad shapes.

Current snapshot body poses are synchronized native QA observations for the available copied hip/spine/thigh anchors; full runtime collider particle transforms at the peak83.17degree frame were not captured.
No skinned cloth vertex/full mesh penetration, every animation, long-session or original-game physics parity conclusion is supported by this review.
